name: MDL 元数据锁诊断
description: Waiting for table metadata lock 是 MySQL 中最常见的 DDL 阻塞场景。DDL 操作需要获取 EXCLUSIVE 级别的元数据锁，而任何正在使用该表的事务（SELECT/DML/甚至未提交的空事务）都持有 SHARED 级别的 MDL，二者互斥。一旦 DDL 被阻塞，后续所有对该表的新请求也会被阻塞，形成锁队列堆积，几秒内即可导致连接池耗尽。

signals.desc: 线程状态显示等待元数据锁
活跃线程突然飙升，伴随大量等待同一张表
metadata_locks 表中出现 PENDING 状态的 EXCLUSIVE 锁请求

conditions.desc: 存在线程处于 Waiting for table metadata lock 状态
metadata_locks 中有 PENDING 状态的锁请求

skip_when.desc: 等待时间 < 5 秒，可能是正常的短暂等待
Online DDL 正在执行 copy 阶段，只在最终 rename 时短暂阻塞
skip_when.condition: ALTER TABLE ... ALGORITHM=COPY 正在 copy to tmp table 阶段

root_causes.name: 长事务持有 MDL 未释放
root_causes.desc: 某个事务执行了 SELECT 或 DML 后未提交，持有 SHARED_READ 或 SHARED_WRITE 级别的 MDL。此时 DDL 请求 EXCLUSIVE MDL 被阻塞，后续新请求也全部排队。最常见于：开发人员开了事务忘提交、ORM 框架自动开事务但未正确关闭、连接池中存在泄漏的未提交连接。

root_causes.name: 慢查询长时间执行占用 MDL
root_causes.desc: 大查询执行时间很长（如分析报表、数据导出），在执行期间持有 SHARED_READ MDL。DDL 必须等该查询完成才能获取 EXCLUSIVE MDL。

root_causes.name: DDL 自身占用 MDL 阻塞后续 DDL
root_causes.desc: 一个 DDL 正在执行（如 ALTER TABLE copy 阶段），另一个 DDL 也尝试获取同表的 EXCLUSIVE MDL 被阻塞。常见于运维脚本重复执行或自动化工具冲突。

root_causes.name: 显式 LOCK TABLES 未释放
root_causes.desc: 某会话执行了 LOCK TABLES ... READ/WRITE 后未执行 UNLOCK TABLES，持有 SHARED_NO_READ_WRITE 或 SHARED_READ_ONLY MDL。

step1_find_mdl_waiters.desc: 找出所有等待 MDL 的线程及其等待时间
step1_find_mdl_waiters.sql: SELECT id, user, host, db, command, time AS wait_seconds, state, SUBSTRING(info, 1, 200) AS query FROM information_schema.processlist WHERE state = 'Waiting for table metadata lock' ORDER BY time DESC

step2_find_mdl_holders.desc: 通过 performance_schema.metadata_locks 找出 MDL 持有者（8.0+）
step2_find_mdl_holders.sql: SELECT ml.OBJECT_SCHEMA, ml.OBJECT_NAME, ml.LOCK_TYPE, ml.LOCK_STATUS, ml.OWNER_THREAD_ID, t.PROCESSLIST_ID, t.PROCESSLIST_USER, t.PROCESSLIST_HOST, t.PROCESSLIST_DB, t.PROCESSLIST_TIME, t.PROCESSLIST_STATE, SUBSTRING(t.PROCESSLIST_INFO, 1, 200) AS query FROM performance_schema.metadata_locks ml JOIN performance_schema.threads t ON ml.OWNER_THREAD_ID = t.THREAD_ID WHERE ml.OBJECT_TYPE = 'TABLE' AND ml.LOCK_STATUS = 'GRANTED' AND ml.OBJECT_NAME IN (SELECT OBJECT_NAME FROM performance_schema.metadata_locks WHERE LOCK_STATUS = 'PENDING') ORDER BY t.PROCESSLIST_TIME DESC
step2_find_mdl_holders.version_note: 需要 8.0+ 默认启用；5.7 需手动启用 instrument

step3_find_blocking_trx.desc: 找出持有 MDL 的未提交事务
step3_find_blocking_trx.sql: SELECT trx.trx_id, trx.trx_state, trx.trx_started, TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, trx.trx_started, NOW()) AS trx_age_seconds, trx.trx_rows_locked, trx.trx_rows_modified, trx.trx_query, p.id AS processlist_id, p.user, p.host, p.db FROM information_schema.innodb_trx trx JOIN information_schema.processlist p ON trx.trx_mysql_thread_id = p.id ORDER BY trx.trx_started ASC

step4_find_long_running_queries.desc: 找出长时间运行的查询
step4_find_long_running_queries.sql: SELECT id, user, host, db, command, time, state, SUBSTRING(info, 1, 200) AS query FROM information_schema.processlist WHERE command != 'Sleep' AND time > 30 AND info IS NOT NULL ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 20

step5_mdl_instrument_status.desc: 检查 MDL instrument 是否启用
step5_mdl_instrument_status.sql: SELECT NAME, ENABLED, TIMED FROM performance_schema.setup_instruments WHERE NAME = 'wait/lock/metadata/sql/mdl'

step6_mdl_lock_detail.desc: 查看当前所有 MDL 锁的完整信息
step6_mdl_lock_detail.sql: SELECT OBJECT_TYPE, OBJECT_SCHEMA, OBJECT_NAME, LOCK_TYPE, LOCK_DURATION, LOCK_STATUS, OWNER_THREAD_ID FROM performance_schema.metadata_locks WHERE OBJECT_TYPE = 'TABLE' ORDER BY OBJECT_SCHEMA, OBJECT_NAME, LOCK_STATUS DESC
step6_mdl_lock_detail.version_note: 8.0+ 默认启用；5.7 需要 setup_instruments 手动开启

step1_mdl_overview.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS mdl_wait_count FROM information_schema.processlist WHERE state LIKE '%metadata lock%'

step2_mdl_detail.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS mdl_lock_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ml.LOCK_STATUS = 'PENDING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pending_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ml.LOCK_TYPE = 'EXCLUSIVE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS exclusive_count FROM performance_schema.metadata_locks ml WHERE ml.OBJECT_SCHEMA NOT IN ('mysql','information_schema','performance_schema','sys')

step3_mdl_blocking_source.sql: SELECT t.PROCESSLIST_ID AS blocking_pid, t.PROCESSLIST_TIME AS time_sec, t.PROCESSLIST_STATE AS state, ml.LOCK_TYPE, ml.LOCK_STATUS FROM performance_schema.metadata_locks ml JOIN performance_schema.threads t ON ml.OWNER_THREAD_ID = t.THREAD_ID WHERE ml.LOCK_STATUS = 'GRANTED' AND ml.LOCK_TYPE IN ('SHARED_READ','SHARED_WRITE') ORDER BY t.PROCESSLIST_TIME DESC LIMIT 10

steps.action: 查看 MDL 等待线程数和等待时间
steps.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS blocked_count, MAX(time) AS max_wait_sec FROM information_schema.processlist WHERE state = 'Waiting for table metadata lock'

steps.action: kill DDL 语句解除排队阻塞
steps.sql: SELECT id, time, info FROM information_schema.processlist WHERE state = 'Waiting for table metadata lock' AND (info LIKE 'ALTER%' OR info LIKE 'DROP%' OR info LIKE 'RENAME%')
steps.note: kill DDL 可立即释放排队的新请求，是最快的止血方案

steps.action: 如仍阻塞，kill MDL 持有的空闲事务
steps.sql: SELECT p.id, p.user, p.host, p.time, p.command FROM information_schema.innodb_trx trx JOIN information_schema.processlist p ON trx.trx_mysql_thread_id = p.id WHERE p.command = 'Sleep' ORDER BY trx.trx_started ASC LIMIT 5
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.processlist WHERE state = 'Waiting for table metadata lock'

version_specific_notes.5.7: metadata_locks instrument 需手动启用。lock_wait_timeout 默认 31536000 秒。不支持 SET PERSIST
version_specific_notes.8.0: metadata_locks instrument 默认启用。支持 SET PERSIST。ALGORITHM=INSTANT 支持部分 DDL 即时完成，减少 EXCLUSIVE MDL 持有时间
version_specific_notes.8.4: ALGORITHM=INSTANT 覆盖更多 DDL 类型。MDL 等待可观测性进一步改善

real_world_examples.scenario: 凌晨 ALTER TABLE 触发级联阻塞导致业务不可用
real_world_examples.symptoms: ALTER TABLE 加字段执行 10 分钟未完成，Threads_connected 从 50 飙到 500，业务报 connection timeout
real_world_examples.root_cause: ETL 任务 30 分钟前开启事务读取该表，执行完毕但未提交，持有 SHARED_READ MDL
real_world_examples.resolution: kill ETL 空闲连接释放 MDL，ALTER TABLE 2 分钟内完成。后续 ETL 改为 autocommit 模式
real_world_examples.result: 连接数 2 分钟内恢复正常，后续 DDL 改用 gh-ost
